title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
summary_lines: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
key_points: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
